hosted_measurement.wrong_field_scope: Errors counted among internally rejected/unaccepted variants; not errors asserted for the selected rows. All rounds nevertheless reuse evaluation data for separator selection.

source_audit.finding: key=(base,action_id)+selected_observations identifies an action-conditioned query, not an action-independent state. With one admitted deterministic destination per key, the multi-route census is zero by construction apart from hash collisions.

Source hash encodes a feature/query tuple; destination hash encodes a string repr of (done/live,changed-cell count,bounding box). The destination is not the same q applied to next_state. These are response predictions, not composable state transitions.

All games and their outcomes influence separator choice in each refinement round and final selection. Leave-one-game-out counts are internal selection statistics, not an untouched final evaluation of the entire fitted pipeline.

Only top 3000 of 33808 accepted rows are saved; no feature bindings, actual actions, decodable target states, or complete support/split manifest are exported. This is a summary artifact, not a reconstructible runtime bank.

Pinned build_agent.py bundles memory_graph, crystal_laws, trace_capabilities, runtime, memory_controller and agent_template. It neither reads this output nor bundles the newer arc_crystal.py. The V2 job does not implement a candidate-versus-baseline policy test.

requirements: Same frozen action-independent encoder at both state endpoints; action stored on the edge.
Preserve UNKNOWN, terminal/progress/resource predicates, and explicit replay/transport scope; observed consistency is not universal warrant.
Save complete executable bindings and lineage, not just hashes or counts.
Separate representation search, model selection and sealed evaluation by original game family/source; report all fixed-model errors without test-based filtering.
Consume bank through a no-LLM candidate controller; verify supported multi-step routes and revoke on mismatched live observations.
Run matched real-environment A/B with all step/reset/replay costs and require nonzero candidate usage and actual improvement before release.

scope: Exact downloaded V2 artifact inspection, independent small representation counterexample, and pinned source audit. No new large-corpus replay or Kaggle score measured. Source/destination intersection is checked for exported entries only. This audit adds evidence only and changes no solver code.
